interface.name: zsingularity_blur_manager_v1
interface.description: Lets a client request a compositor-rendered material behind one of its surfaces. The compositor uses the surface alpha as the material mask.

entry.name: effect_exists
entry.summary: the surface already has an effect object

interface.name: zsingularity_blur_v1
interface.description: Parameters are double-buffered. In version 4, commit stages them for the next wl_surface.commit. They become active with the surface state, including synchronized subsurface commits. In earlier versions, commit applies them immediately.

entry.name: liquid
entry.summary: glass that refracts the backdrop along its edges

request.name: destroy
request.description: In version 4, removal becomes active on the next wl_surface.commit. In earlier versions, removal is immediate.

request.name: commit
request.description: In version 4, copy the parameters to the pending surface state. Later parameter requests do not change this copy until another commit. A wl_surface.commit is needed to apply it. In earlier versions, apply the parameters immediately.

request.name: set_region

description.summary: limit the material to a surface-local region

request.description: A null region selects the complete surface. Pixels with zero or full alpha remain unchanged even when they fall inside the region.

request.name: set_strength
request.description: Values are percentages clamped to 0-100 by the compositor.

request.name: set_corner_radius

description.summary: set the corner radius of the material shapes

request.description: Each connected part of the region is treated as a rounded rectangle with this corner radius, in surface-local coordinates. Refractive materials bend the backdrop along these edges.
